description: The DuckDB column types describe_table reports to the model. Both packages run the case against a real DuckDB table so SQL-native detail, including ENUM labels, cannot be replaced by host-language classes, while values that appear only in inserted rows stay out of model-facing descriptions.

duckdb.create_sql: CREATE TABLE typed (id INTEGER, amount DECIMAL(12,2), happened TIMESTAMP, active BOOLEAN, label VARCHAR, owner ENUM('Alice Smith', 'Bob | Jones'), details STRUCT(owner ENUM('nested ) secret', 'O''Brien | secret'), n INTEGER))
duckdb.insert_sql: INSERT INTO typed VALUES (1, 12.34, TIMESTAMP '2026-10-16 12:00:00', TRUE, 'secret-value', 'Alice Smith', struct_pack(owner := 'nested ) secret', n := 1))

expected_columns.type: STRUCT("owner" ENUM('nested ) secret', 'O''Brien | secret'), n INTEGER)
